messages:
tamika: Compliance asked to extend SAST/DAST evidence retention from 90d -> 365d for two regulated customers. Any blockers? RBAC, KMS, audit implications?

lee: Need clarity: full artifact bundles (logs + attachments + PR snapshots) or only metadata? Which S3 buckets and KMS keys?

maria: Also calling out PII risk for raw DAST request/response bodies. We should not keep raw bodies long-term.

jonathan: Technically possible. Quick checklist: update lifecycle rules (S3), ensure KMS key policy allows decrypt for required principals and retains key material/history, enable S3 data events in CloudTrail, and tighten RBAC for read. Add approval workflow for access >90d.

security-bot: Policy link: https://redwood.internal/policies/evidence-retention (current: SAST 90d, DAST 90d).

tamika: Draft proposal: SAST bundles -> 365d; DAST raw bodies -> 30d; DAST scrubbed artifacts -> 365d; alerts/metadata -> 365d. Approve?

lee: Implementation note: use stable prefixes like scans/<tool>/<team>/YYYY-MM-DD/ for simple lifecycle rules. I'll prepare terraform for lifecycle rules and RBAC policy `scan-evidence:Read` scoped to security and oncall. CI will check for wide principals.

maria: For DAST: keep raw for 30d for triage, then run scrub job to remove PII and store hashes. I can help build the scrub patterns.

jonathan: I'll handle CloudTrail retention and KMS verification. We'll add a nightly assertion to check recent S3:GetObject and KMS:Decrypt events and a Grafana alert if missing.

security-bot: Task created: SE-4210  evidence-retention-extension assigned tamika/lee/jonathan. ETA: 2w.

tamika: I'll open PRs for lifecycle + scrub job + playbook updates. Playbook will cover request flow for `scan-evidence:Read`, ephemeral grants, and justification template.

incident-bot: @oncall acknowledged :eyes:  will review RBAC changes in maintenance window.

lee: Plan to do a canary rollout by prefix, with rollback lifecycle if any issues.

maria: I'll pair on scrub job and PII regex tests.

jonathan: Will include KMS key-policy review and ensure re-encryption isn't required (retain CMK history).

tamika: Thanks team. Will paste PR links here when up.
